name: DemonFly
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a NORTH / REAR view sprite sheet with TWO red demon poses in ONE column. The current wings still incorrectly read as BEHIND the bare torso. Fix the actual occlusion: the WINGS are the CLOSEST layer to the camera in this BACK VIEW. Draw the inner WING MEMBRANES AND BONES OVER THE SHOULDERS AND UPPER BACK, visibly covering most of the shoulder blades and upper ribcage. Do not leave a large uninterrupted bare red back between the wing roots. Fill the inward membrane cutouts across the shoulder-blade area so the wing panels themselves overlap the torso, not merely two thin root lines touching it. Wing layer goes in FRONT OF the upper back and in front of upper arms wherever their silhouettes overlap in this rear view. Head, neck above the attachment, shorts, lower arms/hands and legs remain readable. Do NOT move the outer wing tips or change their existing flap angles: change overlap/layer order over the body. Keep red skin, white horns, face turned away, all character proportions and pixel shading, body pose and original grid1column2rows. No new character, side/front view, text or background. Actual transparent background. This is an occlusion correction: wings drawn as foreground objects across the upper back.

name: GargoyleFly
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 contains 2 NORTH/BACK-view grey gargoyle sprites in ONE column, one sprite per equal square cell. Image2 shows the REQUIRED WING LAYERING on a demon; use it only as a depth/occlusion guide, NEVER copy its red color, horns or body. Edit ONLY the WING MEMBRANES AND BONES where they overlap the torso in image1. Because the camera is behind the gargoyle, the wings are the CLOSEST layer and must visibly cover the shoulder blades, shoulders and most of the upper BACK. The wing panels themselves must overlap the back and upper arms, not merely two thin roots. Do not leave a large bare back covering the wings. Keep roots attached to the back below the neck, outer wing position, silhouette, tips and flap angles unchanged; head remains visible above the wings. Preserve the grey stone character's existing head shape, pointed ears, grey skin and wings, shorts, exact lower-arm/hand and leg poses, scale, crisp pixel shading and cell registration. No red skin, white demon horns or vampire identity. Output exactly1column by2rows, transparent background, no new pose or extra sprite, no text/backdrop/grid. This is a north-view layer-order correction ONLY.
